strings.name: Sachin Tendulkar
strings.summary: Across an international career from 1989 to 2013, Tendulkar became a cricket icon through batting technique, longevity and 100 international centuries. He helped India win the 2011 World Cup and continued cricket and children’s-rights work after retirement, influencing South Asian and global cricket culture.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. Selected milestones; competitions, affiliations and records refer to their cited dates, not an exhaustive match log.
strings.influence.rationale: International records and a World Cup title gave him enduring influence in South Asian and worldwide cricket culture.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: International batting records
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Scored 100 international centuries across Tests and one-day internationals.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: World Cup and public service
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Helped India win the 2011 World Cup and supported UNICEF advocacy.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Children’s-rights advocacy
strings.timeline.event-1.text: As UNICEF’s South Asia Regional Ambassador, welcomed Mandhana to its Indian advocacy team.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: ICC Hall of Fame
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Recognised by the International Cricket Council for his international career.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Bharat Ratna
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Received India’s highest civilian honour, the first sportsperson to do so.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: International retirement
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Retired after his 200th Test, played in Mumbai.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Hundredth international century
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Reached 100 against Bangladesh, bringing his international century tally to 100.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: World Cup victory
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Helped India defeat Sri Lanka to win the men’s Cricket World Cup.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: First men’s ODI double century
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Made 200 not out against South Africa, a men’s ODI milestone.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: First Test century
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Scored his first Test hundred against England in Manchester.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: International debut
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Debuted aged 16 during India’s series against Pakistan.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Mumbai
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Grew up in Mumbai, later trained by Achrekar in school cricket.
